thread:
marie: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem (latency incident on 2026-03-17). The remediation 'rotate model-serving certs' was assigned to @sam and had a due date of 2026-03-20 — it's still marked open. Who's picking this up?

sam: I haven't closed it yet. Procurement is still approving the HSM keys we need. Pushed a note to the ticket yesterday.

marie: Thanks. Can you paste the ticket link? Also we need an ETA — if procurement doesn't unblock by EOD tomorrow, we need a fallback owner.

sam: Ticket: https://rwd.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421. Estimated unblock by 2026-03-25 but that's optimistic. Blocker is KMS key rotation approval.

rajesh: Noted the KMS blocker. FWIW this is the 3rd time cert/key rotation work has slipped after incidents in the last 6 months — recurring pattern. Suggest we add an automatic alert for expiring certs and a runbook task for ownership during outages.

liz: @sam can you confirm by EOD whether you still own? If not, I'll take ownership and coordinate with procurement. We need a hard closure date.

sam: I'll confirm by EOD. If procurement hasn't approved, @liz please take over.

opsbot: INF-3421 created and linked to PM-2026-03 postmortem. Related alerts: infra-cert-expiry, model-serving-latency.

marie: For the add-on (rajesh's suggestion) — can we draft the alert quickly? Something like:
```
alert: ExpiringModelCert
expr: cert_not_after_seconds < 86400 * 14
for: 24h
labels: severity:high, team:infra
annotations: summary: "Model-serving cert expiring in <14d"
```
That will give teams 2 weeks heads-up.

rajesh: I can drop that into prometheus rules and create a small runbook snippet. I'll also add a recurring quarterly cert audit task.

liz: OK — new plan: @sam confirm by EOD. If no confirmation, ownership moves to @liz and new due date set to 2026-03-30. @marie I'll post closure verification once rotated.

marie: Adding one more ask — please mention any follow-up automated mitigations we could add to Redwood Optimize to reduce impact if cert rotations are delayed (e.g., fallback to cached KV for model config).

sam: Will add notes to INF-3421 tonight. Thanks. :thumbsup:

marie: Thanks everyone — tagging this as overdue-remediation-check. I'll update the postmortem action item table after closure.

liz: Ping me if procurement stalls. I'll escalate to procurement lead.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled: INF-3421 follow-up in 24h."
